micronarrative: I feel empathy for the student in the scenario who was just trying to state his opinion, only to have others drown him out with theirs. This resonates because I have had times where I put ideas and opinions forward, and then others would make it all about theirs. Sometimes, this dynamic was influenced by me being in a lower position at work. My upbringing also shapes how I navigate these power dynamics; I grew up with a single mother who raised me and my sister in the housing projects. We had to fight for what we wanted and earn it. Regarding the students arguing about sympathy, I think you either have sympathy or you don’t, or maybe you just didn’t have love in life or a mentor to teach you. That is what helped me; I was taught by many to remember that you haven’t walked in their shoes.
